note: Do not instantiate directly; use itasca.data.vector module functions.

methods.name: extra
methods.description: Get the UDVector extra data in the given slot.

methods.name: group
methods.description: Get the UDVector group name in a given slot.

methods.name: group_remove
methods.signature: vector.group_remove(group_name: str or int[, slot: str or int]) -> bool
methods.description: Remove from the given group from all group slots of the UDVector. One argument of type string, giving the group name, is required. The return value is a bool which is True if the group was removed from any slot, otherwise False.

methods.name: groups
methods.description: Get a dictionary describing which groups this UDVector is part of. The keys of the dictionary are the slot names and the values are the group names.

methods.name: in_group
methods.signature: vector.in_group(group_name: str or int[, slot: str or int]) -> bool
methods.description: Test if the UDVector is part of a given group. If the optional argument slot is given, only that slot is searched. Otherwise, all group slots are searched.

methods.name: pos
methods.description: Get the current position of UDVector.

methods.name: set_extra
methods.description: Set the UDVector extra data in the given slot.

methods.name: set_group
methods.signature: vector.set_group(group_name: str or int[, slot: str or int]) -> None
methods.description: Set the UDVector group name in a given slot.

methods.name: valid
methods.description: Returns True if this UDVector is live.

methods.name: value
methods.description: Get the current value of UDVector.
